definitions.explanation: An official or formal communication informing someone of a decision, requirement, or action. Carries more weight and formality than a simple notification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通告|つうこく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was given notice of dismissal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通告|つうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received notification of contract termination from the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相手国|あいてこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{最後通告|さいごつうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}きつけた→突きつける：10542_tsukitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The government delivered an ultimatum to the other country.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{通|つう}→〜通：04025_tsuu⟧ (communicate, pass through) + {告|こく} (announce, tell). A formal word used in business, legal, diplomatic, and military contexts. Implies authority and finality — the sender has the power to make the decision being communicated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通告|つうこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give notice, to notify formally
- {通告|つうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive notification
- ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧{通告|つうこく}: notice of dismissal
- {最後通告|さいごつうこく}: ultimatum (literally "final notice")
- ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧{通告|つうこく}: advance notice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: notification — more general and neutral, used in everyday contexts
- ⟦{告知|こくち}→告知：17348_kokuchi⟧: announcement, disclosure — often used for medical diagnoses or public announcements
- ⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧: declaration, sentencing — very formal, often legal (e.g., ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧)
- ⟦{通達|つうたつ}→通達：22238_tsuutatsu⟧: directive, circular — an official instruction from a superior authority
